newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow late Friday. Few sales of slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was rather light. Sales confirmed on 1,600 slaughter steers and 1,300 slaughter heifers. Last week's confirmed sales 66,400 head including 13,300 head or about 20 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1175 lbs 67.00; Select with end choice 1200 lbs 67.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1075 lbs 67.00; few select with end choice 1100 lbs 67.00.
